title: Caer Llanwedd
summary: The Duchess's freehold in San Francisco.

claims.text: Inside Caer Llanwedd a glowing green moss carpets every flat surface, dotted with softly shining golden bell flowers; by the Duchess's law every visitor removes footwear at the gates, and refusing is a grave insult.
A pool there bears a mosaic of the Kithain fleeing Earth just before the trods closed.

title: The Ferry Building
summary: A San Francisco landmark seen through Glamour.

claims.text: To mortals the old Ferry Building is a quaint relic of the days when thousands crossed it daily; to fae eyes, chimerical footsteps with no bodies still cross its floors.
The nearby wharves, once busy with gold and supplies, stand nearly empty since shipping moved to Oakland.
